title: Smoke and Sawdust - Pit Firing Workshop
source_quote: Smoke and Sawdust - Pit Firing Workshop Saturday, June 13, 2026 11:00 AM
evidence_sentence: The event listing describes a one-day pit firing workshop where Demetria teaches atmospheric firing in a sawdust pit.
evidence_quote: In this one day workshop, Demetria shares the exciting process of atmospheric firing in a sawdust pit that creates dramatic surfaces on pots from carbonization, flashing and fuming of the smoke and flame.
summary: One-day pit firing workshop on June 13, 2026 in Woodstock, NY. Bring bisqueware to learn sawdust pit firing technique with Demetria Chappo.
